sources.entry: Shaper - Build Data Dashboards all in SQL. Powered by DuckDB. (Demo, Source Code) MPL-2.0 Docker/Nodejs/Python/Go

summary.one_liner: Shaper is an open-source, self-hosted tool for building data dashboards, reports and embedded customer-facing analytics by writing SQL queries, powered by DuckDB.
summary.what_it_does: Dashboards are defined in SQL, with special annotations such as ::LABEL, ::XAXIS, ::CATEGORY and chart types like ::BARCHART_STACKED to control visualization. The README says it can query across data sources and supports a Git-based workflow. For embedding, it mentions white-labeling, row-level security via JWT tokens, and embedding without an iframe through JS and React SDKs. For reporting, it mentions generating PDF, PNG, CSV and Excel output, scheduled alerts and reports, and password-protected shareable links. It can be tried with a single Docker command, and the README points to separate Getting Started and Deployment guides for production use.
use_cases: embed analytics in a customer-facing app
how_to_run: Open the browser at the mapped port (5454) to use Shaper
See the Getting Started Guide for more options
See the Deployment Guide for production setup and security hardening
notable: Dashboards are written entirely in SQL, with inline chart and layout annotations
Embedding without iframe via JS and React SDKs
Exports to PDF, PNG, CSV and Excel with scheduled alerts and reports
caveats: Managed hosting and expert support are offered as paid services by Taleshape, with plans and pricing not detailed in the README
Self-hosted users are responsible for their own security, patching, and compliance posture, as the README's shared-responsibility section describes
